Created for Uncapped Games' first release, Battle Aces; our cinematic follows an ACE preparing for battle.
Crafted for Uncapped Games' debut release,

our cinematic captures the intense moments of an ACE gearing up for battle. This film is the third directorial work by our talented Louve Karnas, who had a clear and compelling vision for this epic right from the outset. Art Director, Bruno, seamlessly translated that vision into reality bringing together 2D and 3D Animation into a cohesive whole. Collaborating with Uncapped was an absolute dream. Every single person involved in this project gave their complete all to it and we couldn't be prouder of the final result.

Moments of epic proportions and actions in films have always had a special place in my heart. To me, it can create some of the most memorable and immersive moments. It’s such a powerful way of telling a story. It heightens the stakes and emotional payoff to the extreme, and I adore it.
That's what I was looking to achieve with Battle Aces.
I wanted the short film to command the room with its pacing, to create tension, excitement, anticipation.
A film that was so dense with details, overwhelming action, striking imagery, that you had no choice but to watch it again to take it all in.
